headline: Your iPhone is now a game controller
lede: Link pads ship: a game screen shows a 4-letter code, phones open the pad page, join, and stream 120 Hz input straight over local Wi-Fi — with a live ping so you can see the latency you're playing on.

notes.text: #893 link pads v1: room-code join, two sticks + four face buttons + shoulders, WebRTC direct with relay fallback, stale-pad auto-release; Gauntlet with two phones works with zero game changes.
Signaling rides inside the relay's already-forwarded 'pad' type, fragmented under its 512-byte budget — no Cloudflare redeploy needed.

#916 merged with uncommitted fixes still in the worktree and main briefly threw on game routes; hotfix #917 adds the missing WebSocket transport + sig fragmentation, proven by a real-Chrome drive (padlinkdrive, 7/7).

look.text: SSX: make the game great — gameplay & feel pass
